rule: Every steady-state status dimension has a measured source or a researched known-absence owner.

input.source: Hive composer and durable outbound journal
input.absenceProof: The generated 0.146.0 ServerNotification and ServerRequest unions contain no editor, selection, IME, composer, or draft events. Codex first observes input at turn/start.params.input; the frontend remains authoritative before submission.

mail.absenceProof: The generated 0.146.0 client/server method unions contain no Hive mailbox methods. Mail is intentionally orthogonal to the vendor runtime and is daemon-measured for every provider.

health.absenceProof: The generated 0.146.0 method unions expose no ping or heartbeat. Hive therefore measures ready from the handshake, freshness from event timestamps, and disconnected/exited from pipe and process termination; it does not invent a vendor heartbeat.

contextUsage.calculation: tokenUsage.total.totalTokens / tokenUsage.modelContextWindow; input/output tokens come from tokenUsage.last. A null context window is a reported absence, never zero.

boundedTransitions.approval: Five-minute default deadline; expiry responds with the least privilege decision and emits elicitation-settled=deny.
boundedTransitions.transportDrop: Pending request acknowledgements become delivery_unknown, while runtime and health immediately become disconnected. Reconnect performs initialize plus thread/resume without resubmitting the prompt.
boundedTransitions.unrecognizedVendorEvent: Retained as unrecognized diagnostic data and never used as lifecycle state.

optionalCapabilities.questions: unsupported by this adapter; 0.146.0 has item/tool/requestUserInput but P4 exposes no answer method through ProviderSession
optionalCapabilities.modeCatalog: unsupported by this adapter; collaborationMode/list is outside the P4 command and session contract
optionalCapabilities.fork: unsupported by P4; thread/fork exists in schema but is outside the first-release common boundary
optionalCapabilities.steering: unsupported by the first release per the design non-goal; turn/steer is never called
